mapper.select: select boqd.Boqd_Code as boqdCode, boqd.Boqd_Name as boqdName, mn.* from Con_Unit_Project_Summary mn left join Con_Boq_Dtl boqd on boqd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id where mn.Mea_Id = #{id}

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, c1.C_Name as mearContName, c1.C_Abbreviation as mearContAbbName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, (select Boqd_Amount from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd left join Con_Boq cb on cbd.Boq_Id=cb.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and cbd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cb.Boq_State=7 ) as mearBoqdAmount, (select Boqd_Price from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd left join Con_Boq cb on cbd.Boq_Id=cb.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and cbd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cb.Boq_State=7 ) as boqdPrice, (select Boqd_Total_Price from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd left join Con_Boq cb on cbd.Boq_Id=cb.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and cbd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cb.Boq_State=7 ) as boqdTotalPrice, (select Boqd_Type from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd left join Con_Boq cb on cbd.Boq_Id=cb.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and cbd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cb.Boq_State=7 ) as boqdType, (select Boqd_Rate from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd left join Con_Boq cb on cbd.Boq_Id=cb.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and cbd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cb.Boq_State=7 ) as boqdRate, (select Boqd_Feature from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd left join Con_Boq cb on cbd.Boq_Id=cb.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id and cbd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cb.Boq_State=7 ) as boqdFeature, boqd.Boqd_Parent_Id as boqdParentId, boqd.Boqd_Amount as boqdAmount, boqp.Boqd_Name as boqdParentName, mn.* from Con_Measure_Record mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Mear_Contractor_Id left join Con_Boq_Dtl boqd on boqd.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id left join Con_Boq_Dtl boqp on boqp.Boqd_Id=boqd.Boqd_Parent_Id left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.Mea_Id = #{id} order by boqdParentName asc

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, c1.C_Name as meaSupeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as meaSupeAbbName, c2.C_Name as meaContName, c2.C_Abbreviation as meaContAbbName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, ces.Ec_Construction_Name as ecConstructionName, ces.ec_Apply_Money as ecApplyMoney, ces.ec_Change_Type as ecChangeType, mn.* from Con_Measure mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Mea_Supervisor_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Mea_Contractor_Id left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id left join con_ec ces on ces.ec_Id = mn.con_Ec_Id where mn.id = #{id}

select sum(Mear_Declared_Total) as declaredAmt, sum(Mear_Final_Total) as examineAmt, (select count(*) from Con_Measure_Record where Mea_Id=#{id} and State!=3) as declaredNum, (select count(distinct rc.Mear_Id) from Con_Measure_Record_Check rc left join Con_Measure_Record mr on mr.id=rc.Mear_Id where mr.Mea_Id=#{id} and mr.State!=3) as examineNum from Con_Measure_Record where Mea_Id=#{id} and State!=3
select sum(Mea_Apply_Amt) as applyAmt from Con_Measure where Con_Id=#{conId} and State=7

select distinct ${selectClause} from Con_Measure mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id
left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Mea_Supervisor_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Mea_Contractor_Id left join Con_Ec ces on ces.ec_Id=mn.Con_Ec_Id where 1=1

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, ces.Ec_Change_Type as ecChangeType, ces.Ec_Construction_Name as ecConstructionName, mn.* from Con_Measure mn left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Con_Ec ces on ces.ec_Id=mn.Con_Ec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Mea_Supervisor_Id where 1=1
